// The wipe target is a member expression. It cannot be resolved statically, and
// must be REPORTED rather than silently contributing nothing.
process.env.NODE_ENV = 'local';

const { db } = require('../../src/utils/firebase');
const { clearCollection } = require('../helpers/firebase-emulator');

const config = { collection: 'users' };

beforeEach(async () => {
  await clearCollection(db, config.collection);
});
